description: Unpublish a live form. The hosted URL stops accepting responses and any embed rendering it goes dark, so this is visible to everyone who can reach the form — pass confirm=true when the user authorized taking this form offline. Otherwise ask for their decision. Existing responses are kept and the form becomes a draft you can publish again. Already-draft forms succeed unchanged. Needs forms:write.

confirm.description: Set true when the user has authorized this action on the specified target in the task or workflow. Ask only if that authorization is missing.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_unpublish_form
title: Take a form offline
